data.text:
The evidence from anomalies (T1), KPI queries (T2), and external events (T3) shows that traffic and active users spiked on sites S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 between 18:15 and 21:45. This spike coincides exactly with EVT-004, a stadium event at the Rades Olympic complex near S-TUN-001, starting at 18:10 and ending at 21:49. There are no major or critical alarms, transport failures, or bad changes causing this; it is a clear case of capacity congestion due to an external event (stadium crowd).

The traffic jump in Grand Tunis yesterday evening was caused by a stadium event (EVT-004) at the Rades Olympic complex near S-TUN-001, which drove up user numbers, data volume, and PRB utilization across S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 between 18:15 and 21:45.

data.markdown:
# Traffic Jump in Grand Tunis Due to Stadium Event

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-001`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct timing match with stadium event EVT-004, confirmed KPI spikes, and checked absence of maintenance or changes.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-25 18:15 to 2026-09-25 21:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-25 18:10
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003

## Summary

A stadium event at the Rades Olympic complex drove up user numbers, data volume, and PRB utilisation on nearby sites S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003.

Traffic, active users, PRB utilization, and latency spiked on three sites in Grand Tunis between 18:15 and 21:45.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-25 18:10: Stadium event at Rades Olympic complex started. [EVT-004]
- 2026-09-25 18:15: S-TUN-003 dl_volume_mb and active_users went above baseline. [T2]
- 2026-09-25 18:30: S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 metrics spiked above baseline; ALR-0030 alert started. [T1, T2]
- 2026-09-25 18:50: Warning high PRB alarm raised on S-TUN-002. [ALM-000580]
- 2026-09-25 18:58: Warning high PRB alarm raised on S-TUN-001. [ALM-000581]
- 2026-09-25 21:45: KPIs recovered to baseline and ALR-0030 ended. [T1, T2]
- 2026-09-25 21:49: Stadium event at Rades Olympic complex ended. [EVT-004]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users, latency and PRB utilisation spiked on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003. [T1]
- Stadium event EVT-004 occurred at the Rades Olympic complex near S-TUN-001 from 18:10 to 21:49. [EVT-004]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003 and parents between 17:00 and 23:59. [T5]
- No changes occurred on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003 and parents between 17:00 and 23:59. [T6]
- Only warning-level PRB alarms occurred during the incident window. [T4]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. Traffic spike timeline precisely matches the stadium event duration and location near S-TUN-001. [T2, EVT-004]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-001: rejected. Change log check showed no changes during the incident window. [T6]

## Ruled out

- ALR-0029: Relates to a separate site S-TUN-006 earlier in the day and concerns a drop in metrics, not a traffic jump.
- T5: No maintenance was scheduled, ruling out planned work as a cause.
- T6: No configuration changes were made, ruling out human error or bad changes.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor stadium event schedules to proactively anticipate localized traffic spikes.
- Review capacity scaling for sites near the Rades Olympic complex during large events.
